newsitem.title: USA: MCI to offer joint video network-NYT.
newsitem.headline: MCI to offer joint video network-NYT.

text.p: MCI Communications and Internet software company Progressive Networks are expected to announce a service Tuesday that will let thousands of computer users simultaneously receive video broadcasts, the New York Times reported.
The new service will be known as Realnetwork, the paper said.

The companies claim Realnetwork contains the seeds of a system that will someday expand to offer individualized interactive digital television that is indistinguisable from conventional broadcasts, the paper said.
